incidents.name: TBBuild burnToHolder reward accounting
incidents.notes: TBBuild.burnToHolder() credits the caller with rewards proportional to a burn it never charges against the reward pool, so the attacker burned flash-bought PDZ and drew the payout with receiveRewards().

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x664201579057f50D23820d20558f4b61bd80BDda created 2024-01-25T19:19:37Z by 0xf9daa56857df4edebb5ca4adc7c8db39fc683422, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x48234fb95d4d3e5a09f3ec4dd57f68281b78c825; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 3.3 BNB x $834.26/BNB at the incident timestamp 1755306491 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $2,753.
